used_propositions: Meridian Energy Partners invoices are described as the advisory retainer under MSA-MER-2024.
The billed name recorded in billing data is Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
MSA-MER-2024 is titled Advisory retainer and lists Counterparty: Meridian Energy Partners LLC.
Section 9 Assignment of MSA-MER-2024 states that Meridian Energy Partners LLC may not assign the agreement to a competitor of the provider.
support_claim: Evidence associates Meridian Energy Partners LLC with billing activity and names it as counterparty on MSA-MER-2024, but no proposition establishes that billing:Meridian Energy Partners LLC and contract:MSA-MER-2024 denote the same legal counterparty.
